title: Bluey Economy
description: "The ultimate economy plugin with custom Bluey currency and trader villagers
body:
🐾 Bluey Economy The ultimate, high-performance economy ecosystem for modern Minecraft servers. Bluey Economy introduces a unique physical currency system and interactive traders to keep your community engaged and your server's economy balanced.

✨ Key Features 💎 Custom Physical Currency: Uses a special "Bluey" item (Blue Dye) with custom metadata and protection against duplication. 👨‍💼 Bluey Trader & Refounder: Craft and spawn dedicated NPC traders to serve as your server's primary economic hub, buying and selling items. ✨ Custom Trails & Kill Animations: Players can unlock and equip custom particle trails and unique kill effects! 🏆 Custom Leaderboards: Spawn live, holographic leaderboards to track the top players for Wealth, Total Kills, and Kill Streaks. 💾 Persistent Data: Robust data management ensures your economy stays stable and secure across server restarts.

⚙️ Compatibility Tested on: PaperMC 1.21.11. Supported Loaders: Paper, Purpur. Note: This version has only been extensively tested on 1.21.11. Compatibility with other versions is likely but not guaranteed.
